name: R.A.I.N. hydrogen producer
description: A contraption that almost looks haphazardly constructed. An industrial air fan on one end, and an outlet on the other, with 2 hoses perfect for attaching to vehicle fuel systems. One of which has a permanent fixture pointing downwards, almost as if it was suppost to be unused. Takes power and generates hydrogen gas, perfect for powering various R.A.I.N. equipment.
